name: kmedoids
expr: [idx, C, sumd, D, midx, info] = kmedoids(X, 3); [idx2] = kmedoids(X, 3, 'Distance', 'cityblock'); [idx3, ~, sumd3] = kmedoids(X, 3, 'Replicates', 2);
comment: Sig: [idx, C, sumd, D, midx, info] = kmedoids(X, K, 'Distance'/'MaxIter'/'Replicates'/'Algorithm'/'Start', val, ...). Default Distance is 'sqeuclidean' (per R2025b — not 'euclidean'). Fingerprints are label-permutation-invariant (cluster counts + same-cluster boolean tests + output shapes) because RNG init differs between engines (joint with normrnd spec for full label parity).
